evals.prompt: Blazor WASM 前端调后端 API，登录后 Authorization 头没有带上去，请求 401。
evals.expected_output: Checks the auth-header injection path: manual DelegatingHandler chain vs shared HttpClient DefaultRequestHeaders.
assertions: Prescribes DefaultRequestHeaders injection on a singleton client

evals.prompt: 评论加载失败，登录总报用户名或密码错误，后端日志里根本没有请求到达。
evals.expected_output: Identifies relative api/ paths resolving to the frontend origin and centralizes URL resolution.
assertions: Checks every cross-backend call goes through one resolver

evals.prompt: 改了 wwwroot/config.api.json 切换 API 模式，重启浏览器页面还是旧行为，后端日志沉默。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses dev-server ETag caching and the committed mode-config trap; recommends build-time generated config per form.
assertions: Restarts dev server / verifies served bytes
Treats mode config as build-time artifact

evals.prompt: 后台编辑保存成功，但公开页面还是旧内容，硬刷新才变。
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes session-scoped cache staleness from display-precedence shadowing and prescribes the no-session-cache contract.
assertions: Checks AddScoped singleton-like session cache first
Tests request count increases on re-read

evals.prompt: 给这个 Blazor 组件写 bUnit 测试覆盖渲染和交互。
evals.expected_output: Routes component test authoring to ada-blazor-bunit-testing.
assertions: Does not treat as API integration

evals.prompt: 把 Blazor WASM 站点部署到 GitHub Pages 并加 SPA 兜底。
assertions: Does not apply API integration pitfalls

evals.prompt: 编辑了 .NET 工程，需要跑构建测试格式门禁。
Blazor WASM 的 JS interop attach 只在真实浏览器失败，bUnit 全绿。
evals.expected_output: Routes JS interop diagnostics to ada-blazor-interop-pitfalls.
assertions: Does not narrow to API integration
